text:
Kylian Mbappé has been dropped by two major brands in China after a video circulated online in which the France striker apparently joked about the former leader Mao Zedong. In China jokes about Mao, the founding leader of the People’s Republic of China who died in 1976, are considered disrespectful and remain a social taboo.
“Our company firmly opposes and has a zero-tolerance policy towards any behaviour that offends national sentiments,” the drinks company Dongpeng said in a statement on Tuesday, adding that “with immediate effect we are terminating all cooperation with Kylian Mbappé”.
Adverts showing AI-generated images of the 27-year-old France captain drinking a Dongpeng sports drink were regularly shown in China during this year’s World Cup.
Mengniu, China’s largest dairy producer, also cut ties with the Real Madrid forward, who has been hugely popular among Chinese fans with millions of followers on social media. Mbappé is fondly nicknamed “Guigui”, the Chinese translation of “Turtle”, due to his popularity as a character in a Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles meme.
“With immediate effect our company is terminating all cooperation with Kylian Mbappé,” Mengniu said in a statement. “Mengniu firmly opposes and has a zero-tolerance policy towards any words or actions that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people,” it added.
The announcements came after a video emerged online with Mbappé saying that the funniest internet meme he had seen was of his face photo-shopped on to that of “some guy – I think he’s a Chinese dictator”.
This was an apparent reference to a meme of Mbappé superimposed on an image of Mao, one of several using the footballer’s face and other historical figures. The authenticity of the video could not immediately be verified by AFP Fact Check.
“Dongpeng Beverage ends cooperation with Mbappé” was the top-trending topic on the Chinese social media site Weibo. One Weibo user said that the “extremely serious wrong remarks … crossed the red line. They are completely unacceptable”. Others urged Dongpeng to remove Mbappé’s image from their energy drink bottles.
Dongqiudi, one of China’s biggest online football outlets, said in a statement on Monday evening that Mbappé’s remarks were “offensive to China and the Chinese people” and “have hurt the feelings of Chinese football fans and the Chinese people”.
Mbappé in September addressed a previous meme depicting him as a military dictator, in an interview with the French sports newspaper L’Equipe. “There’s a part of it that’s funny. You can tell that, for some people, it’s all in good fun. But there is another part that’s a bit less funny because of the damage such people have caused throughout history,” he said. “Being compared to individuals who murder others, or who have brought misery to millions upon millions of people – well, I don’t think I’ve ever done anything like that in my life,” he said.
The furore in China came a day after Mbappé lost out to Harry Kane for the Ballon d’Or, the most prestigious individual award in football.
Global sports stars who have commented on sensitive topics such as Taiwan, Tibet and Hong Kong have previously caused controversy in China and been dumped by sponsors there. The former NBA player Dwight Howard referred to Taiwan as a country in 2023 as he appeared in a video with the island’s vice-president and current president, Lai Ching-te, sparking fury on Chinese social media. Beijing claims Taiwan is part of its territory and has threatened to use force to bring it under its control.
The Houston Rockets general manager, Daryl Morey, posted a tweet in 2019 supporting Hong Kong protests, leading to China suspending sponsorship deals with the NBA and pulling games off Chinese television for a year.
digest_he:
חברת המשקאות דונגפנג ויצרנית החלב מנגניו בסין הודיעו על סיום מיידי של כל שיתופי הפעולה עם חלוץ נבחרת צרפת וריאל מדריד, קיליאן אמבפה. ההחלטה התקבלה בעקבות הפצת סרטון ברשת שבו לכאורה התבדח שחקן הכדורגל על חשבונו של מאו דזה-דונג, המייסד המנוח של הרפובליקה העממית של סין.

שתי החברות הדגישו בהצהרותיהן כי הן נוקטות מדיניות של אפס סובלנות כלפי כל התנהגות הפוגעת ברגשותיו של העם הסיני. הנושא הפך במהרה לנושא המדובר ביותר ברשת החברתית Weibo, כאשר גולשים רבים גינו את דבריו ודרשו להסיר את תמונותיו ממוצרי החברות. התקרית מגיעה זמן קצר לאחר שאמבפה הפסיד להארי קיין במירוץ לזכייה בכדור הזהב.
